EvidenceBody: Miyun says, 'turn illumination back and look straight down,' without reference to any direction. Yuanwu says that if the matter is not yet recognized, one must turn illumination back, whether moving, still, standing, walking, sitting, or lying down, and investigate its root.

Senses.Explanation: An imperative to turn illumination back or turn the light around. Miyun says, 'turn illumination back and look straight down,' without reference to any direction. Yuanwu says that if the matter is not yet recognized, one must turn illumination back, whether moving, still, standing, walking, sitting, or lying down, and investigate its root.
